description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related nested classes within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. It provides interfaces and implementations for system information management, including identifiers, network, security, location, time, and provisioning data, with methods for setting, retrieving, and notifying changes.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class managing system information and notifications, implementing ISubSystem and IMetadata interfaces.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents system identifier details, including architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Handles internet connectivity information such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Stores geographic location data including timezone, country, region, and city.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client for system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SecurityCallsign
methods.description: Returns the callsign associated with system security.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Major
methods.description: Returns the major version number of the software.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Minor
methods.description: Returns the minor version number of the software.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Patch
methods.description: Returns the patch version number of the software.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns the build tree hash string.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Set
methods.description: Sets system information based on the specified subsystem type and data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current information object for a specified subsystem type.

methods.name: SystemInfo::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a subsystem type is active.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Value
methods.description: Returns the current flags value representing active subsystems.
